title: Upgrade CsWinRT to 2.3.1 and Windows SDK .NET ref pack to 10.0.26100.87

review.body_prefix:
**Current-head assessment:** The update now pairs the central CsWinRT 2.3.1 declaration with Windows SDK .NET ref pack 10.0.26100.87, updates the CmdPal template's CsWinRT version and public SDK dependency, and replaces interface-targeted collection expressions across the affected modules with concrete arrays or read-only wrappers. The shared CsWinRT1032 suppression is limited to test projects; Settings.UI.UnitTests now preserves inherited NoWarn entries.

The existing Actions contract-v4 checks remain the runtime gates, with platform-guard annotations rather than an added redundant OS check. The submenu update uses a concrete typed array. Peek's existing ComImport casts have a scoped CsWinRT1033 suppression and a tracked follow-up, rather than a claim that they are now AOT-safe. The earlier hypothetical sample-default mutation concern is not supported by the unchanged settings update/rendering path.

**Validation scope:** These are exact-head source checks, not an independently passing complete build or a runtime-compatibility approval. The author's updated description reports module test results and WinRT.Runtime output/audit results, while explicitly recording local linker, resource-loading and unrelated runtime-version failures. Those reports remain attributed to the author; the current CI builds are still in progress.

The maintainer's CmdPal sign-off is scoped to that portion and predates this latest merged-main head; other module ownership remains separate. Old-host/new-extension and new-host/old-extension activation, command and callback compatibility have not been independently established here. The template deliberately retains its earlier SDK ref-pack pin, so successful template compilation and the compatibility matrix should not be inferred from the central version declarations. No additional demonstrated code defect or duplicate author request is asserted by this summary.
